name: Dundalk Leisurecraft Georgian Cabin 2-6 Person Outdoor Sauna w/ Changing Room
description: Georgian Cabin Sauna with Integrated Changeroom – A Luxurious Wellness Retreat Transform your home into a luxurious escape with the Georgian Cabin Sauna with Changeroom, an elegant fusion of comfort and relaxation. Part of the Canadian Timber Collection by Leisurecraft, this premium sauna is crafted from Eastern White Cedar with a light, knot-rich finish that radiates natural beauty. Its classic cabin shape harmonizes effortlessly with any outdoor space, whether at a cottage or home. Step inside to enjoy the soothing embrace of heat therapy, where stress melts away and rejuvenation takes center stage. The convenient changeroom allows for a seamless transition from preparation to relaxation, ensuring a private, tranquil experience. Built with durability in mind, the Georgian Cabin Sauna features a metal shingle roof for all-weather protection, keeping your sauna dry and ready to enjoy year-round. Key Features Integrated Changeroom Adds convenience, allowing for an uninterrupted wellness experience. Metal 28 Gauge Shingle Roof Made in Canada 28 gauge steel roof panels in black matte textured color. Front Windows Large front windows with 5mm bronze tempered glass in the front wall and middle sauna wall. 2 Tier Benches 2 Tier benches on the back wall and single-tier L bench can be on either side. Videos Warranty The Canadian Timber Collection by Dundalk LeisureCraft Inc. saunas are warranted against defects in materials and workmanship under normal/residential use for a period of three (3) years, as applicable, from the date of receipt of the product. This warranty does not apply to normal wear and tear and/or natural weather conditions. This warranty does not cover regular required maintenance of the sauna, (eg. Tightening bands on the barrels, cleaning or staining the sauna) refer to your sauna assembly manual for maintenance guidelines. This warranty does not cover misuse or negligence and the manufacturer and associated retailers are not liable for any injury or damage caused by the product. This warranty is a parts-only warranty and any service or labor costs would not be considered part of the 3-year warranty.
